name: Aletheia Framework
//: One-click cloud dev environment for GitHub Codespaces. On create it installs Aletheia and all its dependencies (incl. the spaCy model + knowledge graph), so `python main.py` just works.
// postCreateCommand: Runs once when the Codespace is built. Installs the package with dev + graph + web extras; falls back to a direct spaCy model download if the pinned wheel is ever unreachable.
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install --upgrade pip -q && pip install -e '.[dev,graph,web]' && (python -c 'import en_core_web_sm' 2>/dev/null || python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm) && echo '\n✅ Aletheia is ready. Try:  python main.py   (or  python main.py --web  for the browser UI)'
// forwardPorts: 8000 is the web UI (python main.py --web); Codespaces will offer to open it in your browser.
// ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Do NOT put your API key here. Set it as a Codespaces secret (see the README 'Run it in the cloud' section) so it's injected securely and never committed.
